title: Description of the Use of fidAxomicin in Hospitalized Patients With Documented Clostridium diFficile iNfection and of the managEment of These Patients
brief_summary: The study aims to describe the characteristics and the methods of management and follow-up of patients treated with fidaxomicin for Clostridium difficile infection (CDI).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalized patient
* Patient diagnosed with CDI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient already included in this study
* Patient is taking part in a clinical trial in the field of CDI
study_population: Adult hospitalized patients diagnosed with clostridium difficile infection
